execution.progress: Paid work in one-unit increments whose exact job, escrow, worked quantity and position persist across interruption; resume pays only the next increment after revalidation; completion, failure, cancellation and death settle once.

details.costs: Start: inputs lists 1-24 {itemId, quantity} allocations in 0.1 steps from exact owned, unreserved, unspoiled stacks of one food that your own record shows as edible with toxicity 0 (raw, or food already combined this way); preparation is cold-combine (default). Work equals the selected quantity: one food unit per round at one energy per unit worked, so 3 units take 3 rounds and 3 energy and a final partial unit costs its fraction. Start pays the first increment and the same action continues each round; resume pays the next increment of the unfinished process; cancel takes one round and no energy. No vessel, water, fuel or tool is needed or provided. Travel, gathering and eating are separate actions with their own costs.
details.effects: Start moves the selected quantities into a reserved in-progress portion that stays carried and owned, keeps its origin, age and decay, and keeps ageing. Completion replaces it with one portable prepared stack of the same food holding the same quantity and mass, with the original lots kept as separate component records. It eats exactly like that food through eat (same nutrition and toxicity per unit, the ordinary eat cost and satiety cap; a part eaten debits those lots), and each lot spoils under the existing rules without any shelf-life reset. No washing, cutting, heating, detoxification, preservation, digestibility change, extra nutrition, mastery or reward; preparing does not feed anyone. Work not continued in a round pauses with progress and ingredients kept; too little energy pauses without spending. A lost or spoiled reserved ingredient stops the work and returns the survivors. Cancel returns the remaining reserved food in its current condition; spent energy and time are never refunded. Death stops the work and leaves the unfinished food on the ground. Different foods cannot be combined in this version because no consistent per-portion mixture rule is represented; heated, wet or tool-based preparation is not implemented.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 4000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form.
